text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Heh... A victory for now, I suppose.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
It wasn't a bad race. I was able to give 
it everything I had.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
"...However, it's still not enough. The 
heat is still smoldering inside me..."
choice_data_list: Let's go find the next strong opponent!
Want to do some training once we're back?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
"...However, it's still not enough. The 
heat is still aching inside me..."
choice_data_list: Let's go find the next strong opponent!
Want to do some training once we're back?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
I'm off to meet folks who can fire me up. 
Off to meet folks who can quench my 
thirst.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: For that sake... All I can do is run.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Please. If I don't, I don't think I'll be 
able to sleep.
choice_data_list:
Make sure to get plenty of rest after 
that!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
I know. ...You always have to say one 
thing too many, don't you?
